messages:
noah: tiny dilemma  found a mug with a tiny chip in the bottom in the sink. it's decorated with a unicorn sticker. do we have an unclaimed mascot mug? :unicorn_face:

lina: omg that's probably Sir Mugsworth. legend says it chooses coworkers. i've seen it on three different desks. :face_with_monocle:

maya: Confirmed. Sir Mugsworth appeared after the Great Late-Night Deploy. got a battle scar during the incident. it whispers to interns.

jeff: not me. i only drink from the Thermos of Destiny (sacred, untippable). :thermos:

noah: should we stage a small ritual? like a tiny shelf by the coffee station. title it "Chosen Vessel". low-budget shrine.

lina: vote: shrine = 1, no shrine = 2. tally pls.

noah: 1

maya: 1

tara: 2 (i respect ritual but am allergic to clutter)

ops-bot: Reminder: items left in common areas are personal property. If you find a lost item, please file here: https://redwood/internal/lostfound (auto) :bell:

lina: side poll: best hiding spot for a prank mug swap? under the ficus, supply closet top shelf, taped under the standing desk?

maya: under the ficus. it becomes part of the plant mythos. :deciduous_tree:

jeff: taped under the standing desk, classic.

noah: plan: hold mug for one week. if unclaimed by Friday, we make the shrine and crown it Sir Mugsworth. who will write the plaque? haiku preferred.

maya: i will write a haiku. low-effort high-legend.

lina: pls include the year of the Great Coffee Spill. adds gravitas. :sparkles:

jeff: pinging facilities so it doesn't get tossed during cleanup. @ops-bot can you notify them?

ops-bot: Message sent to #facilities. Response ETA: 24-48h. :white_check_mark:

noah: archival intent: saving this thread as official provenance. future archeologists will find it in the company lore index. :museum:

maya: also, i'll drop a photo in the company lore folder. for posterity. :)
